title: Tax Bulletin: Sales Tax on Refunded Parcel Charges for Undelivered Parcels
content:
Finance Tax bulletin for Delivery Claims. The sales tax refunded with the delivery charge of a parcel that never reached the customer, on a Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim, is set by the order's ship-to state.

**Rule.** The tax on the refunded parcel charge depends on the ship-to state: where the order went to a state in the delivery-taxing list, it is the refunded parcel charge times the order's sales tax divided by the order's net merchandise (subtotal less discounts) plus its effective shipping fee and surcharge; where the order went to a state in the taxable-share list, which taxes a delivery charge only in proportion to the taxable merchandise the parcel carried, that same amount is further multiplied by the order's net merchandise less its gift-card lines, divided by its net merchandise; where the order went to any other state, no tax is added.

| List | States |
|---|---|
| delivery-taxing list | AR, CT, GA, HI, IN, KS, KY, MI, MN, MS, NE, NJ, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, VT, WA, WV, WI |
| taxable-share list | CO, IL, MD |

## Definitions

- Ship-to state: the state of the order's shipping address.
- Net merchandise: the merchandise subtotal shown on the order less its discounts. Sales tax, effective shipping fee and surcharge: as shown on the order.
- Gift-card lines: booking lines whose merchandise class is a Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card or a plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, at their booked amounts.

## Worked figures (hypothetical order)

Refunded parcel charge 9.00 USD; sales tax 7.20 USD; net merchandise 110.00 USD; effective shipping fee 9.00 USD; surcharge 1.00 USD; gift-card lines 22.00 USD.

- Shipped to PA: 9.00 times 7.20, divided by 120.00, gives 0.54 USD.
- Shipped to MD: 0.54 times 88.00, divided by 110.00, gives 0.432 USD.
- Shipped to CA: no tax.
